rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for tuna, including the fish and tuna used as food.

example.traditional: 我最鍾意食吞拿魚三文治。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 sik6 tan1 naa4 jyu2 saam1 man4 zi6

rows.note: Use this when you need to make clear that you mean the edible flesh rather than the whole fish.

example.english: This tuna meat is best for making sushi.
example.traditional: 呢啲吞拿魚肉用嚟整壽司最正。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 tan1 naa4 jyu2 juk6 jung6 lai4 zing2 sau6 si1 zeoi3 zing3
